routines.name: packet_global_value_set
routines.scope: Destination global write comparison for fixed edge values and 128 deterministic 32-bit values, including zero and all-ones.

routines.name: packet_callback_reset
routines.scope: Two global resets and optional callback dispatch comparison for null and three non-null targets, with eight prior callback-byte values.

limitations: Callback dispatch is represented by a native resolver for SH-4 target addresses; unmapped-memory exceptions are outside these tests.
